crossRefs.note: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt…
Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his…
but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore…
One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on…
Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply…
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
translations.bsb: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
translations.kjv: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
translations.asv: How then canst thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
